name: Investigator / Opportunist
life_theme: Build thorough knowledge, then share it through stable networks of trusted relationships.
work_pattern: Research deeply before acting. Opportunities come through existing relationships, not cold outreach. Career moves are best made through people who already trust and know you.
career_approach: Build your network intentionally and maintain it genuinely. Your next role will likely come from within your existing circle. Invest deeply in both expertise and trusted relationships.
growth_edge: Not becoming so research-dependent that action is delayed indefinitely.
